summary: Creating a scientifically defensible synthetic cloud-removal benchmark for LISS-IV using the existing repository is currently BLOCKED. The repository contains only a single cloudy monsoon acquisition (no cloud-free LISS-IV reference scene exists), product metadata lacks solar exo-atmospheric irradiance (ESUN) required for physical reflectance calibration, and the existing U-Net baseline cannot ingest LISS-IV's Green-Red-NIR band combination without a Blue channel.

missing_parameters.esun_solar_irradiance: Absent from metadata (BAND_META.txt and .meta contain no ESUN values)
missing_parameters.radiance_units: Units for Lmin/Lmax (e.g. mW/(cm^2*sr*um) vs W/(m^2*sr*um)) are not declared in deliverable text
missing_parameters.atmospheric_correction_coefficients: No aerosol optical thickness, water vapor, or atmospheric profile parameters provided

calibration_assessment.sufficiency_verdict: INSUFFICIENT for defensible surface reflectance conversion without external unverified assumptions.

reference_imagery_assessment.current_scene_cloud_status: Monsoon acquisition with extensive cloud cover and saturated core pixels (DN = 1023 in all bands). Cannot be treated as clean ground truth.

synthetic_utilities_assessment.mask_generation: Multi-scale Gaussian stochastic noise field (coarse + fine turbulence) providing continuous opacity alpha in [0.0, 1.0]. Algorithmically sound.
synthetic_utilities_assessment.blending_formulation: Standard simplified radiative transfer: I_cloudy = (1 - alpha) * I_clear + alpha * C. Supports 10-bit integer DN ranges.
synthetic_utilities_assessment.tool_suitability: SUITABLE algorithmically for synthetic cloud overlay, but physically constrained by the lack of a clear LISS-IV base image and uncalibrated radiometry.

blockers.title: Absence of Clear LISS-IV Reference Scene
blockers.description: The repository contains exactly one LISS-IV scene, which is heavily cloudy. A synthetic benchmark requires a genuinely cloud-free scene (<= 1% cloud) to serve as Y_clear ground truth. Fabricating ground truth from cloudy imagery is scientifically invalid.
blockers.evidence_needed: Acquisition of an authentic, verified cloud-free LISS-IV scene from Bhoonidhi.

blockers.title: Missing Solar Spectral Irradiance (ESUN) in Metadata
blockers.description: BAND_META.txt provides radiance limits (Lmin, Lmax) but omits mean solar exo-atmospheric spectral irradiance (ESUN). Converting TOA Radiance to TOA Reflectance is mathematically impossible without external, sensor-specific calibration tables.
blockers.evidence_needed: Authoritative NRSC/ISRO published ESUN calibration constants for Resourcesat-2A LISS-IV Bands 2, 3, 4.

blockers.title: Spectral and Architecture Incompatibility with Existing Model
blockers.description: The existing compact U-Net baseline requires Red-Green-Blue inputs. LISS-IV provides Green-Red-NIR. A synthetic LISS-IV benchmark cannot be evaluated against the current checkpoint without training a dedicated False-Color Composite (FCC) model.
blockers.evidence_needed: Training an FCC-specific (Green, Red, NIR) baseline model on matching SEN12MS-CR bands (B03, B04, B08).

accuracy_claims: No accuracy claims (MAE, PSNR, SSIM, or benchmark performance) are made on LISS-IV. No synthetic benchmark dataset was generated.
